units.source_text: 两个人也没有别的去处，就从龙岗町走到池端，进了上野公园。

en.t: Since the two of us had nowhere else to go, we walked from Tatsuoka-cho to Ikenohata and entered Ueno Park.

units.source_text: 这时他突然主动谈起了那件事。

en.t: At that moment, he suddenly brought up the matter of his own accord.

units.source_text: 从前前后后的情况综合考虑，我判断K是为此事特意拉我出来散步的。

en.t: Taking everything that had happened before and after into account, I judged that K had deliberately taken me out for a walk because of this matter.

units.source_text: 但是，他的态度依然没有朝着实质性的方向进展一步，

en.t: However, his attitude still had not advanced even one step in any practical direction,

units.source_text: 只是笼统地问我：‘你怎么想的？’

en.t: and he merely asked me vaguely, 'What do you think?'

units.source_text: 这句问话的意思是，对于堕入情网的他，我是怎么看的。

en.t: What he meant by that question was how I viewed him now that he had fallen into love.

units.source_text: 一句话，他想知道我对他现在的看法。

en.t: In short, he wanted to know what I thought of him as he was now.

units.source_text: 我想，由此可以确认他与平时的不同之处了，

en.t: I thought that from this I could clearly recognize how different he was from his usual self,

units.source_text: 我曾经说过多次，他的个性并不懦弱，不大在乎别人对自己的看法，

en.t: As I have said many times, his nature was not weak, and he did not care much what others thought of him,

units.source_text: 他有胆有识，只要认定一点，就敢于一个人向前突进。

en.t: he had courage and judgment, and once he decided on something, he was bold enough to push ahead alone.

units.source_text: 在他和养父家的那件事上，就充分反映出他的个性，让我难以忘怀。

en.t: That aspect of his character had been fully revealed in the affair with his adoptive family, leaving an impression on me that I could not forget.

units.source_text: 因此，我敏锐地觉察到了他今天的反常表现，也是顺理成章的。

en.t: Therefore, it was only natural that I sharply sensed how unusual his behavior was today.
